test.title: Giving old clothes a new life

paragraphs.text: Every year, millions of tonnes of clothing are thrown away in Europe, and less than one per cent of the material is made into new clothes. Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One obstacle is that many garments are made from blends of fibres, such as cotton mixed with polyester. These are difficult to separate, and most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A Swedish company has developed a process that uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester. The recovered cotton is turned into pulp and then into new fibre, while the polyester can be melted and reused.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Second-hand shops also play a part. However, charities report that the quality of donated clothes has fallen, because cheaper garments wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some governments now require clothing brands to pay for collecting and recycling the garments they sell. Supporters say this will encourage companies to design clothes that last longer and are easier to recycle.
paragraphs.label: E

document.title: Giving old clothes a new life

items.quote: Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned
items.prompt: Most textiles that are thrown away

explanation.en: Discarded clothing: “Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned”. Landfill means “buried”, and “burned” is the same → E.
explanation.kk: Тасталған киім: «Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned». Қоқыс полигоны — «buried», жағу — «burned» → E.
explanation.ru: Выброшенная одежда: «Most textiles end up in landfill or are burned». Свалка — это «buried», сжигание — «burned» → E.

explanation.en: Blended fabrics “are difficult to separate” → C. G is about the machines, not the garments.
explanation.kk: Аралас маталар «are difficult to separate» → C. G киімге емес, машинаға қатысты.
explanation.ru: Смешанные ткани «are difficult to separate» → C. G относится к машинам, а не к одежде.

items.quote: most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre

explanation.en: “most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre” → G. The grammar helps too: “machines … can handle”.
explanation.kk: «most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre» → G. Грамматика да меңзейді: «machines … can handle».
explanation.ru: «most recycling machines can process only a single type of fibre» → G. Грамматика тоже подсказывает: «machines … can handle».

items.quote: a process that uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester

explanation.en: “uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester” → D. “Two materials” are cotton and polyester.
explanation.kk: «uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester» → D. «Two materials» — мақта мен полиэстер.
explanation.ru: «uses heat and water to separate cotton from polyester» → D. «Two materials» — хлопок и полиэстер.

items.quote: cheaper garments wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell

explanation.en: Cheap garments “wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell” → A. Selling abroad (F) is not in the text.
explanation.kk: Арзан киім «wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell» → A. Басқа елге сату (F) мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: Дешёвая одежда «wear out quickly and are often too damaged to sell» → A. F про продажу в другие страны в тексте нет.

options.text: are often too worn to be sold again.
could lead to longer-lasting clothing designs.
are hard to recycle because their fibres are mixed.
uses heat and water to separate two materials.
are usually sold to other countries.
can handle only one kind of fibre.
